scope: Public website and appointment-request pages; clinical care and patient data are outside scope.

metrics.label: Published opening schedule
metrics.context: Sunday closed. Published on the official website at the snapshot; may change.

metrics.label: Online request lead time
metrics.context: Two full business days; a published request rule, not a measure of appointment availability.

observations.title: Separate same-day calls from later appointment requests
observations.observed: The homepage advertises same-day appointments. The online request page says requests must be at least two full business days ahead and require staff confirmation.
observations.improvement: Pair choices: call for same-day availability or request a later appointment. Repeat the lead-time and staff-confirmation rule beside the homepage button.

observations.title: Make email routes consistent or explain their roles
observations.observed: The reviewed header email icon and footer email link point to different clinic email addresses. Both are public business routes, but their different purposes are not explained there.
observations.improvement: Confirm the preferred general-inquiry address; standardize links or explain each route's role. Test both internally without assuming either is unmonitored.

sources.label: Homepage / schedule and public contact links
Appointment request / lead time and confirmation

limitations: The form loaded, but submission and delivery were not tested. Neither public email route is assumed inactive; appointment availability was outside scope.
Public website review only. No forms submitted or mobile-usability, conversion, speed or internal-system tests performed.
